name: 20 simulated PM2.5 monitors, annual PM2.5 per monitor

spatialCoverage.name: Los Angeles, California, United States (10 km window)

description: SIMULATED network of 20 PM2.5 monitors placed at random (at least 150 m apart) in a 10 km window around downtown Los Angeles, the first 20 of a nested series of networks of 20, 60 and 200. A monitor reads the simulated exposure field of the OHDSI GIS raster example at its site plus noise (SD 0.3 ug/m3), one annual mean per year 2014-2019. It is not a measurement of any real exposure.

about.name: ETL process for the simulated monitor network
about.description: The CSV (WKT point plus an annual jsonb series) is published by the monitors generator and loaded into a raw table with ogr2ogr; the postgis step builds the typed table.

variableMeasured.name: pm25_monitor
variableMeasured.description: Annual mean PM2.5 reading of the monitor, stored as a jsonb object keyed by startDate/endDate (YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD) with the PM2.5 value for each year.
